---
applyTo: "**/*.cs, **/*.csproj"
---

# .NET Instructions

- Use .NET 10 and C# 14 idioms.
- Prefer file-scoped namespaces.
- Enforce nullable reference types without discarding warnings.
- Public APIs require XML documentation comments.
- Follow naming conventions: PascalCase for types and methods, camelCase for parameters and private fields.
